description: iPhone app (and Android twin): NyxCitadel in a native shell that loads the live site (server.url with ?shell=store, which hides buying inside the store app) - the same pattern as Feed the Bear's installed app. Subscriptions are bought on nyxcitadel.com and unlock in-app after sign-in. This pack lives with the Feed-The-Bear repo's iOS workflows because that repo's GitHub secrets hold the working App Store Connect key.
name: nyxcitadel-native
